h1: Irrigation equipment and farm water solutions across Kenya
intro: DripTech Eco Flow supplies drip irrigation equipment, sprinklers, pumps, filtration, pipes, fittings and complete irrigation kits. We help farmers match equipment to the crop, plot, water source and available pressure, with delivery and installation support confirmed for each project location.

sections.heading: Start with the farm, not a generic package
paragraphs: Two farms in the same county can need different systems. Crop spacing, soil, field shape, water availability, elevation, operating pressure and water quality all affect the design.
A practical recommendation should identify the water source, pump or gravity supply, filtration, mainline and submain sizes, irrigation zones and operating schedule before materials are selected.

sections.heading: Explore irrigation support by area
bullets: Nairobi: compact and peri-urban farms, vegetable plots, nurseries and greenhouse irrigation.
Kisumu: irrigation planning for vegetable and horticultural plots, alongside the region's established rice-growing schemes.
Nakuru: crop-aware drip and sprinkler options for mixed farms, vegetable production and horticultural operations.
Nanyuki and Laikipia: irrigation planning for horticulture, greenhouse production, water storage and varied water sources.

sections.heading: Equipment and services
paragraphs: Browse dripline and drip tape, sprinklers, filters, pumps, valves, fittings, fertigation equipment and irrigation kits. DripTech can also help with system design, equipment selection and installation support.
Delivery, site visits and installation availability depend on the exact location and project scope. Contact the team to confirm arrangements before planning a visit or ordering.

sections.heading: What to send for a useful recommendation
bullets: Your town or area and the approximate size of the plot
The crop and planting arrangement or row spacing
The water source: tank, dam, river, borehole or another supply
Available pump details, tank height or operating pressure, if known
A field photo, sketch or layout showing the water point and irrigated area

title: Irrigation Systems in Nairobi | Drip, Sprinkler & Farm Equipment | DripTech
description: Irrigation equipment and system guidance in Nairobi for vegetable plots, nurseries, greenhouses and peri-urban farms. Get help with drip, sprinklers, pumps and filters.
h1: Irrigation systems and equipment in Nairobi
intro: Nairobi farming includes compact urban and peri-urban growing spaces as well as larger plots around the county. DripTech Eco Flow helps match irrigation equipment to the crop, available space, water source and pressure instead of recommending the same kit for every site.

sections.heading: Choose a system for the growing space
paragraphs: For vegetable beds and closely planted crops, drip irrigation can deliver water along the rows and make it easier to manage separate beds or zones. The correct dripline spacing and flow rate depend on the crop, bed width, soil and operating pressure.
Nurseries and greenhouse sites may need drip, micro-irrigation or sprinklers depending on the plants, container layout and required coverage. Open plots may use a different arrangement again.

sections.heading: Plan around Nairobi's site constraints
bullets: Measure the available growing area and identify the water point before choosing a kit.
Check whether supply comes from a tank, mains connection, borehole or another source.
Confirm the height of an elevated tank or the pump's flow and pressure at the working point.
Allow for filtration, flushing access and separate valves where different crops need different watering schedules.
Plan pipe routes carefully where space, buildings or paved surfaces limit installation.

sections.heading: DripTech equipment and support
paragraphs: DripTech Eco Flow supplies driplines, drip tape, emitters, sprinklers, filters, pumps, pipes, valves, fittings and complete irrigation kits. We can help prepare a practical equipment list and discuss design or installation support for your site.

We serve customers across Kenya; this page does not represent a walk-in Nairobi branch. Confirm delivery, site-assessment and installation availability for your specific Nairobi location before making arrangements.

sections.heading: Request a Nairobi irrigation recommendation
paragraphs: Send your area, crop, plot dimensions, water source and a photo or sketch of the site. Include pump details or tank height if available. This makes it easier to assess the likely system type and identify what still needs to be measured before a final quotation.

title: Irrigation Systems in Kisumu | Drip Irrigation & Equipment | DripTech
description: Irrigation equipment and design guidance in Kisumu for vegetable plots, horticulture and farms. Explore dripline, sprinklers, pumps and filtration with DripTech Eco Flow.
h1: Irrigation systems and equipment in Kisumu
intro: Kisumu County has established irrigated rice-growing areas as well as farms producing vegetables and other crops. DripTech Eco Flow helps assess the right equipment for each site, taking account of crop layout, water source, pressure, filtration and field conditions.

sections.heading: Match the irrigation method to the field
paragraphs: Ahero and West Kano are established rice irrigation schemes where basin irrigation is used. Those large scheme layouts are not interchangeable with a drip kit for a smaller vegetable plot, orchard or greenhouse. The system should be selected for the actual crop and field rather than assuming one method suits every farm.

For row vegetables and horticultural crops, drip irrigation may be appropriate where rows, soil and water supply support it. Sprinklers can suit other coverage needs, including some nurseries and open plots. The choice should follow a site assessment.

sections.heading: Water source and filtration need attention
paragraphs: The Ahero scheme draws irrigation water from River Nyando, while West Kano abstracts water from Lake Victoria. Farms using river, lake, dam or other surface-water sources should assess the water before selecting a filter. Sediment and organic material can affect emitter performance and maintenance requirements.
Pump selection should account for the required flow, operating pressure, elevation and pipe losses—not only the size of the farm.

sections.heading: Equipment for Kisumu farms
bullets: Driplines, drip tape and emitters for suitable row-crop layouts
Disc or screen filtration selected for the actual water source
Pumps, pipes, valves and fittings sized for the design flow and pressure
Sprinklers and rain guns where the crop and coverage pattern call for them
Fertigation components where nutrient injection is part of the farm plan

sections.heading: Get a Kisumu-specific equipment list
paragraphs: Share your area, crop, acreage, water source and whether the field is already served by an irrigation scheme. A photo of the intake, tank, pump or field layout is useful. DripTech can help identify the checks required before a final design and quotation.
Delivery, site visits and installation support are confirmed according to the project location and scope. This page is not an address for a local walk-in branch.

title: Irrigation Systems in Nakuru | Drip, Sprinkler & Farm Equipment | DripTech
description: Explore irrigation systems in Nakuru for vegetable farms, horticulture and mixed crop production. DripTech supplies dripline, sprinklers, filters, pumps and fittings.
h1: Irrigation systems and equipment in Nakuru
intro: Nakuru farms range from mixed crop enterprises to specialist horticultural operations. DripTech Eco Flow helps farmers compare drip irrigation, sprinklers and supporting equipment based on the crop, field size, water supply and the pressure available at the farm.

sections.heading: Select irrigation around the crop and planting pattern
paragraphs: Vegetable beds and horticultural plots need a layout that matches row spacing, root zone, soil and the required watering frequency. Dripline emitter spacing and flow rate should be selected for the crop and bed arrangement, not simply by choosing the longest roll.

Sprinklers may suit crops or areas that need broader coverage. Greenhouses, nurseries and open fields can require different equipment, so confirm the application rate, coverage, pressure and spacing before buying.

sections.heading: Check water supply, pressure and filtration
bullets: Identify the water source and whether supply is continuous or stored.
Estimate the flow available during irrigation, not just the total water stored.
Check pump capacity, elevation, pipe length and pressure at the furthest irrigation point.
Choose filtration according to water quality and emitter or sprinkler requirements.
Divide large or uneven plots into zones where the water supply cannot operate the whole field at once.

sections.heading: Irrigation equipment from DripTech Eco Flow
paragraphs: The range includes dripline and drip tape, sprinklers, filters, pumps, HDPE and irrigation pipes, valves, fittings, fertigation equipment and irrigation kits. The team can help prepare a parts list and discuss design or installation support for your farm.

DripTech serves customers across Kenya. Delivery, site visits and installation availability in Nakuru are confirmed for the exact town or farm location and project scope; this page does not imply a physical branch in Nakuru.

sections.heading: Request a Nakuru farm assessment or quote
paragraphs: Send the crop, acreage, town or area, water source and a field sketch or photographs. For an existing pump, include its model or nameplate details. These inputs help identify the measurements needed for a reliable design and quotation.

title: Irrigation Systems in Nanyuki & Laikipia | DripTech Eco Flow
description: Irrigation equipment and planning for Nanyuki and Laikipia farms. Explore drip, greenhouse irrigation, pumps, filters and water-storage options with DripTech.
h1: Irrigation systems for farms in Nanyuki and Laikipia
intro: Farms around Nanyuki and across Laikipia include crop production, horticulture and greenhouse operations. DripTech Eco Flow helps match irrigation equipment to the crop, water source, storage, elevation and field layout so the system is designed around the farm rather than a generic acreage package.

sections.heading: Irrigation planning for Laikipia crops
paragraphs: Laikipia's crop and horticulture activity includes vegetables, tomatoes, French beans, chillies, watermelon and fruit production. Some horticultural and greenhouse production relies on irrigation from dams, water pans, boreholes and rivers, so the water source and storage arrangement are important design inputs.

For row crops and horticulture, drip irrigation can help deliver water along the planting rows. Greenhouse layouts may need carefully zoned drip or micro-irrigation. Sprinklers may be suitable for other applications, depending on crop and required coverage.

sections.heading: Water storage, pumping and pressure
bullets: Confirm whether the farm uses a dam, water pan, borehole, river intake or storage tank.
Check the usable water volume and the time available to irrigate each zone.
Measure the elevation difference between the source, pump and field.
Size the pump and pipes for the required flow and pressure after accounting for pipe losses.
Select filtration based on the water source and the type of emitters or sprinklers.
Plan zones and flushing points to make operation and maintenance practical.

sections.heading: Equipment and support for Nanyuki-area farms
paragraphs: DripTech Eco Flow supplies dripline, drip tape, filters, pumps, sprinklers, pipes, valves, fittings, fertigation equipment and complete irrigation kits. We can help assess the system components and discuss design, supply and installation support.

This is a service-area page, not a claim that DripTech operates a walk-in shop in Nanyuki. Confirm delivery, site-assessment and installation availability for your specific location and project before making arrangements.

sections.heading: Request a Laikipia irrigation recommendation
paragraphs: Send the farm location, crop, irrigated acreage, water source, storage details and a photo or sketch of the field. For pumped systems, include the pump model or nameplate if available. We can then identify the information needed to develop a practical layout and bill of materials.
